header: Astryx components have a Fluid component of their own
bodytext:
Astryx, the design system from Meta that this catalogue is built on, publishes 164 components. 159 of them have a Fluid counterpart here, so a TYPO3 template can use them by name.

The other five are not missing pieces. Theme, MediaTheme, LinkProvider, InternationalizationProvider and AppShell are React context providers: they hold settings for the components inside them and render no markup of their own, so a server-rendered page has nothing to draw for them.
note: Counted against Astryx v0.6.2, from Astryx for TYPO3 2.1 onwards. The package’s component map lists each of the five with its reason.
